## Summary

<!-- Briefly describe what this PR changes and why. -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `refactor` / `test`: Maintenance, refactoring, or tests

## Security & Privacy Checklist (Required)

- [ ] Pre-commit security hook is installed locally (`scripts/setup_hooks.ps1` on Windows or `scripts/setup_hooks.sh` on macOS/Linux) and passes cleanly
- [ ] Zero PII, email addresses, phone numbers, or API keys/secrets are included in code, docs, or commit history
- [ ] No files from `vault/`, `history/`, `.env`, `logs/`, `*.sqlite`, `*.db`, or `storageState.json` are staged or committed
- [ ] Any new configuration or profile templates use unmistakable placeholder tokens only

## Branch & Commit Hygiene

- [ ] Branch name follows `spdwivedi/<feature>` or `<friend>/<feature>`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `refactor:`, `test:`)

## Verification

- [ ] Tests and local validation checks pass after the final edit
